records.currentAcademicCriteria:
All students must graduate from high school (or secondary school) according to their own country before starting at BYU–Hawaii. High school seniors may submit a current transcript with an anticipated graduation date, but may need to provide an official transcript after being admitted to BYUH.
There is no minimum GPA requirement, but the GPA averages of incoming students can be found here: https://admissions.byuh.edu/new-international-students 
Students who have not finished high school must either complete it, an equivalent, or apply as a transfer student. Transfer applicants need at least 24 university credits, preferably through BYU Pathway Worldwide. Pathway Connect alone does not meet this requirement, as its courses are not university-level.
records.englishTestRequired: Students who indicate a primary language other than English on their application must submit a valid English proficiency test. Additionally, applicants from the following countries are required to submit an English test even if they list English as their primary language.
records.optionalToSubmit: In general, any college entrance exam that acts like an ACT/SAT is optional to submit. Some countries, due to limited access to their high school academic documents or history are required to submit a college entrance exam.
records.expiredCountryCriteria: These country criteria are no longer being used. Do not give reponses baseed on this information as it is outdated, but this can be useful for the ChatBot to know as far as understanding the history of the country criteria we required in the past.
